Ways to Kill a Vampire - Volume one

This text goes on and on to tell of the many ways to kill a vampire. It mentions a former Overlord's Greatsword which would be instrumental in this purpose..

This armor grants additional protection to its wearer, and bears the hallmarks of Nattick Nimblefingers, the great tailor of Lankhmar's Tenderloin District.

Kumal's ledger has the details of dozens of fencing jobs detailed within it.

items.Description: As with many weapons, the kama was adapted for combat by the peasants that used them as farming implements, often because they were forbidden from owning swords or the like.

items.Name: Lankhmar Morningstar
items.Description: The morningstar is a derivative of the mace that includes a chain tether - similar to the flail - to add velocity when swinging its compact striking surface. Morningstars commonly have at least one formidable spike as an added feature of the head.

items.Name: Lankhmar Ash Shortbow
items.Description: A shortbow has a stave portion of about five feet in length. The shortbow was the first of such launchers to be developed, and it remains an effective weapon.

items.Name: Lankhmar Short Sword
items.Description: One of the first types of sword to come into existence, the short sword is a double-edged weapon about two feet long. It is an economical weapon, and a favorite of archers and rogues.

items.Name: Lankhmar Sickle
items.Description: The sickle is a farming implement used for cutting grass and grains. Like many other such tools, it was adapted for use as a weapon by the peasants familiar with it in their daily toils.

items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker. It might make a good tournicut in a pinch.

Torches are little more than wooden rods topped by flax or cloth and soaked in tallow or some other flammable liquid. Very useful except when one wishes to be stealthy.

The Steppes

The Steppes are a huge region of grassy plains extending far to the east of the known lands. This is the land of the Mingols, the savage breed of nomadic horsemen who often terrorize the more civilized lands of Nehwon. 

The northern border of the Steppes is general…

Seas of Nehwon

items.Description: The Overlord's Chosen were the names of the old Overlord's elite warriors, and their weapons. Being able to show the sword usually often got them through any resistance from the local city folk.

items.Name: Overlord's Diary
items.Description:
This is the Diary of Overlord Jusinlay Favitrexis, whom, over 100 years ago, went into the catacombs with a magic sword that was supposed to protect him from the undead. 

There is a passage missing due to age, but somehow the late Overlord got separated from his sword. Somethin…

items.Name: Painted Shell
items.Description: This painted blue shell should get you into Durkul's place.

items.Name: Darkwolf Ring
items.Description: This ring has the marking of Purde Darkwolf - Enemy of the Overlord at large.

items.Name: Phenalope Ring
items.Description: A singularly beautiful stone, phenalope is dusty pink in color, dramatically marked with black streaks. Even when mounted in jewelry, phenalope maintains a rough texture, pocked with tiny holes that cannot be polished out. For some, this is part of the stone's attraction, and th…

items.Name: Physician's Garb
items.Description: Piecemeal or complete armors of this grade are meager protection, no better than garments made of cloth or even rags.

items.Name: Pit Fighter Note
items.Description:
"Drink the potion after you get to the Temple of Kos. Afterward, find me in the usual place."

-Terqqal

items.Description: Made of hot liquid poured over scorched and pungent beans, this strong-smelling brew did not get its name from its appearance. It helps clear and fortify the mind and body for the heroic tasks ahead..

items.Name: Potion of Water Breathing
items.Description: Potions of Water Breathing help when searching water-filled lairs.

items.Name: Pulgh's Armor

items.Name: Purdue's Cloak
items.Description: Cloaks are a common clothing item in Lankhmar.

items.Name: Pure Ginko Root Extract
items.Description: Made of hot, pure ginko root- extract liquid poured over scorched and pungent beans, this strong-smelling brew did not get its name from its appearance. It helps clear and fortify the mind against spells that affect the mind.

items.Name: Quarmall Noble Ring
items.Description: This ring and several of its type were originally crafted to protect the sons of the Quarmall King Uasten Rist, though the creator is unknown. items.Name: Staff of Raistlin
items.Description: Created by the archmage of Krynn, Raistlin, this type of staff is the pinnacle of the artificer's craft, and each one represents the culmination of decades of study by a master spellcaster. The staff is party cursed, in that the user takes on some of the frailties of the staff's…
PropertiesDecoded: Mage Armor (2) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Rapier of Muskatel
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Rat Hide Armor
items.Description: This hide armor appears to be made from the physical skin of a wererat. It is said that they must be skinned alive for the hide to be harvested. The hide actually protects from rodent-based diseases.

items.Name: Rations
items.Description: It should provide some substinance, though the taste leaves much to be desired.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Red God Temple Key
items.Description: This key unlocks a side door to the Red God's Temple.

items.Name: Red Cloak Note
items.Description:
"As agreed upon, get my daughter's cloak back from that thieving Garonn. I have your payment enclosed."

-Duke Danius

items.Name: Red Lankhmar Cloak of Protection
items.Description: This cloak, made from eastern silks, was crafted by Lankhmar's famed clothier, Nattick Nimblefingers.

items.Name: Red God Follower Cloak
items.Description: Cloaks are a common clothing item in Lankhmar. These cloaks are worn by followers of the Red God.

items.Description: The Red God Ring is worn by priests of that eastern Order.

items.Description: Rey Gorra's Amulet of Shielding was crafted for him from a family brooch.

items.Description: Rey Gorra's Great Helm was specially crafted for him. It was given to him by his parents, when he left with the Lankhmar guard.

items.Name: Rey Gorra's Large Shield +2
items.Description: This magic shield bears the hallmark of lthmar Pirates. Rey took it from a pirate captain that he beat in single combat.

items.Name: Rey's Longsword
items.Description: This magic weapon was taken from a pirate captain that Rey bested in single combat, on one of his missions in the Lankhmar Guard.
PropertiesDecoded: Lawful Neutral Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Description: Piecemeal or complete armors of this type are considered equivalent to chain mail. This armor grants additional protection to its wearer, and it bears the hallmarks of Nattick Nimblefingers.

items.Description: This ring was designed by a Lankhmart Wizard merchant that literally would not take 'no' as an answer to get what he wanted.

items.Name: Ring of Projections (Powerless)
items.Description: The Ring of Projections was used by Ulat to create temporary spectral copies of himself. When he died, it became useless.

items.Name: Ring of the Bizarre Bazaar
items.Description: Not much is known about where the beings came from that inhabited the Bizarre Bazaar. What is known is that Fafhrd put a stop to them.

items.Name: Ring of the Thief
items.Description: This plain-looking ring pulsates with a faint glow and is warm to the touch.

items.Name: Fire Magician's Robe of Kereith
items.Description:
The Fire Magician's of Nehwon's East give these fire-resistant robes to  their apprentices that go out into the world on their own.

This silk masterpiece has been enchanted by Kereith herself, as a part of her studies.

items.Name: Leather Armor +2
items.Description: This magic armor grants additional protection to its wearer, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Blade of Roggor
items.Description: Roggor's magic blade has a haste enhancement upon it. This was why he was called 'Roggor the Quick'. He was also known for double-dealing - no one is sure if that is related to how he lost this fine magic sword.

items.Name: Rope Coil
items.Description: You never know when a ropre coil will come in handy.

items.Description: This unlocks something nearby.

items.Name: Rugo's Key
items.Description: This unlocks a jail cell in Rugo's estate.

items.Name: Sapphire
items.Description: This Sapphire is roughly cut, but worth some serious money.

items.Name: Sea Note

items.Description: Sea of Monsters Water is in this figurine.

items.Name: Servant of Mog's Robe
items.Description: The Servant of Mog's Robe is designed to protect from ornery spiders. It is crafted from rare Quarmallian silk.

items.Name: Sewer Key
items.Description: This key opens a door into the sewers that brigands use to enter and leave Lankhmar.

items.Description: This large fold out map of Lankhmar allows you to travel faster across the various districts of the great city.

items.Description: Cloaks of this sort are made from the hide of sharks, and have minimal protection against piecing and slashing attacks.

items.Description: This key will open a door in the Shark cult temple.

items.Name: Sheelba's Robe
items.Description: Black Wizard's Robes give limited protection to positive magic.

items.Name: Sheelba's Stone
items.Description: Sheelba's Stone was given to you by that selfsame sorcerer. You'll need it to complete her quest.

items.Name: Sheelba's Symbol
items.Description: This roughly-polished stone is incised with a few runes spelling out allegiance to Sheelba. It can also be used for protection against mental magic.

items.Name: Shree-kah Robe
items.Description: The Shree-kah garb covers a lot of the body, so Lankhmarts don't see the changes happening.

items.Name: Shrine Key
items.Description: This key is used to open the Red God Shrine back door to the Salt Marsh.

items.Name: Silver Medallion
items.Description: This special silver medallion of a spider pendant is on a thin chain. It is worth a lot because of the fine craftsmanship and enchantment upon it.

items.Name: Shree-kah Leader's Key
items.Description: This unlocks a door in the Noble Crypts.

items.Name: Slaver Note
items.Description: According to this slave manifest, the buyers of this group's slaves are in Ilthmar.

items.Name: Slayer Dagger
items.Description: This is a Slayers' Brotherhood dagger. It is left behind as a warning after a kill, to let others know who was responsible for committing the deed.

items.Name: Slayer Note
items.Description:
"Bring this note back with Myrra's ring finger, so our employer will pay us."

-Slayer Chief Gross

You should take this with you, it could be worth some money down the line.

items.Name: Slayers’ Guild Contract
items.Description:
Rodolfo bears this slip of parchment an official Slayers' Guild contract signed clearly by himself and Black Garrick, detailing the job that was to be performed. 

One might question the sense of a hired killer carrying evidence of who he works for. Remember, in Lankhmar, this i…

items.Name: Slayers' Note
items.Description:
"Your quarry should show up at the Silver Eel sooner or later. Don't let them get away with the jewels.

You two Slayers are some of the fastest agents we have, so get the job done quickly! 

If they feign ignorance, it doesn't matter. You can just as easily take their loot off …

items.Name: Slyth's Thieves' House Note
items.Description:
Even though Mako has hired the Guild to steal the figurine, we do not hire out like carpenters. Yes, we have accepted Mako’s commission and will try to steal the figurine, but we also intend you to plunder the temple. 

Having taught Mako a lesson in Guild business practices, ma…

items.Name: Social Level
items.Description:
An important concept in Lankhmar is the relative importance and influence of each person, expressed as a social level. 

The highest social level, reserved for the Overlord, is 15; while the lowest, signifying persons of nearly all professions who have yet to prove their worth.
…

items.Name: Son of Nalgron
items.Description: This weapon has a bonus to attack, and bears the hallmark of Rivis Righby, the master swordsmith of Lankhmar. It was created from shards of the sword of Fafhrd's late father, Nalgron.

items.Name: Sea Salt Spider Key
items.Description: This key opens a door on the Sea Salt Spider.

items.Name: Staff of Striking
items.Description: This Staff of Striking is enchanted petrified wood, and it offers better than average blunt force when used.

items.Name: Stravas' Rope
items.Description: Stravas gave you this rope to see what the strange lights were on the top of the temple of the Gods of Lankhmar.

items.Name: Talisman of Pure Good (vs. Black Wizards)
items.Description: Made to combat Black Wizards, these holy talismans border on the power of artifacts. Only a good creature may wear one, and even the most beatific finds his soul challenged and refined, as the device makes him more and more righteous with every passing day. Examples of these ite…

items.Name: Temple Note
items.Description:
"Your destination is the Temple of the Gods of Lankhmar on the corner of Nun Street and the Street of the Gods. You know what will happen if you fail" 

-Slayer Chief Gross

items.Name: Terol's Glass
items.Description: Terol was an investigator for the Overlord. Many spoke of his ability to identify unknown items. It appears that this magnifying glass supports the tales.

items.Name: The Book of Antiquities and Lost Treasure
items.Description:
This book is crammed with ancient maps, diagrams, and legends of treasure. 

A strange map with old writing has slipped out of the book.

A note in the front of the book states that the book can be returned (between the hours of 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.) to Lord Rannarsh, in the Noble …

items.Name: The Cat's Cradle
items.Description:
The name of this area comes from a legendary rat chieftain who is said to have kept a tamed cat which defended his tunnels from ambitious rat raiders. 

This somewhat implausible legend is given some credibility by the unusually great size of the main entrance passage and centra…

items.Name: The Map of Ilthmar Sewers
items.Description:
This is a map of the Ilthmar sewer network and the city's vulnerable spots. 

This would be invaluable to someone who is planning to invade Ilthmar.

items.Name: Therluss' Employment Note
items.Description: Therluss gave you this note to show that you have a contract to help him find his daughters.

items.Name: Amulet of the Thieves' House
items.Description: This amulet shows thieves and others that you are in good favor with the Thieves' House of Lankhmar.

items.Name: Member Amulet of the Thieves' House
items.Description: This amulet is given to thieves that are members of the Thieves' House.

items.Name: Thief's Note
items.Description:
This note, with dried blood on it, details how a group of Ilthmart thieves came out to this quarantined ship from the docks a few days ago.

They killed the crew, and stayed here to loot the ship, while their partners took the ship's goods back to the docks.

You assume whomever…

items.Name: Thieves' House Robe
items.Description:
This armor grants additional protection to its wearer, and bears the hallmarks of Nattick Nimblefingers, the great tailor of Lankhmar's Tenderloin District.

It would be greatly unwise, even for a non-guild rogue, to wear this armor in public.

items.Name: Tower of Angarngi Treasure Keystone
items.Description: This keystone case holds the Tower of Angarngi Treasure. It will take some time to decipher the unlocking mechanism which can open it.

items.Name: Thieves' House Leather Armor
items.Description:
This armor grants additional protection to its wearer, and bears the hallmarks of Nattick Nimblefingers, the great tailor of Lankhmar's Tenderloin District.

It would be greatly unwise, even for a non-guild rogue, to wear this armor in public.

items.Description: Cloaks are a common clothing item in Lankhmar.

items.Name: Uluthtc Summoner
items.Description: Made of some unidentified alien material, the Uluthtc Summoner can bring the same aberration you slew back to fight by your side - but just for a short period of time.

items.Name: Valinor Note
items.Description:
"Please come see me in Bones Alley. I have need of your services."

There is a lion crest and a signature

-Tanya Valinor

items.Name: Venaerium
items.Description: This seems to be the last of many pieces of Venaerium, mines from a small cavern below Lankhmar.

items.Description: Water is needed to replenish the fighting spirit.

items.Description: Enchanted by Black Wizards over 150 years ago, this heavy flail belonged to one of the former ruling dukes of Lankhmar, Yesgrid Mathikios. Yesgrid is know for usurping power, but gave it up soon after he slew his traitorous ducal council.

PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: White Wizard Potion
items.Description: Created by White Wizards, this potion restores life force drained by creatures that channel negative energy. The murky liquid glows when brought near a living being, but the ingredients are impossible to discern.
PropertiesDecoded: Lesser Restoration (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: White Wizards of Nehwon
items.Description:
Members of this small fraternity of spellcasters are even rarer than their black counterparts. White wizards tend to be recluses, avoiding all unnecessary contact with the outside world.

All clerical and druidic spells are available white wizards. Any spell may be chosen regard…

items.Name: Will of the Rats
items.Description: Strangely, the well-worn grip of this weapon is a furniture pattern, The club itself being a leg from the central table in a 500-seat festhall in Ilthmar. The hall was the heart of a rat warrior clan, and the site of their last stand during the invasion of the Mingol Horde. In t…

items.Name: Wilting Blade
items.Description: The Wilting Blade was created by the black wizard Charinni. It is imbued with her spell, the God of Lankhmar Horrid Wilting. It drains the endurance from a struck target.

items.Name: Wine
items.Description: Either a dark red or pale yellow, wine is made from the pressing of grapes that have been fermented and aged.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Wine Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Withering Club
items.Description: Used by the Gods of Lankhmar, the Withering Club is a fearsome weapon; made to destroy life.

items.Name: Wensbane's Note
items.Description:
Wensbane's note is to Hresstan:

I am sorry my old friend. I realized, too late, that my gambling has turned me to black magic, and to the path of evil. If I am to meet my end, let it be at the hands of the most powerful of my comrades..

items.Name: Wolf's Head
items.Description: This is the head of one of the animals that took over the Playhouse.

items.Name: Wood
items.Description: Excellent fuel for a future fire.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: General Worlga's Legionary Scabbard
items.Description: General Worlga's Legionary Scabbards hold the blades carried by that legion's own officers.

items.Name: Kaddish Scimitar
items.Description: This scimitar is larger than most, and is crafted specifically for Kaddish desert warriors.

items.Name: Your Silver Eel Key
items.Description: This key is for your room door.
